title.fr: Quiz 1 du prof (tutoriel 1, exigences et gabarit SECRET)
title.en: Teacher’s quiz 1 (tutorial 1, requirements and the SECRET template)

instructions.fr: Questions du prof, en anglais, sans corrigé dans les fichiers : les réponses sont **proposées** (déduites du tutoriel et du cours). Plusieurs réponses justes possibles quand l’énoncé dit « Select all correct statements ».
instructions.en: The teacher’s questions, with no official answers in the files: the answers are **proposed** (deduced from the tutorial and the course). Several answers may be correct when the statement says “Select all correct statements”.

question.fr: Which statement primarily specifies a functional capability?
question.en: Which statement primarily specifies a functional capability?

options.fr: The editor shall provide the user with the ability to open a file.
options.en: The editor shall provide the user with the ability to open a file.

options.fr: Each stored file shall occupy no more than 100 MB.
options.en: Each stored file shall occupy no more than 100 MB.

options.fr: The interface shall achieve a specified usability score.
options.en: The interface shall achieve a specified usability score.

options.fr: The project shall be delivered before a specified date.
options.en: The project shall be delivered before a specified date.

options.fr: The editing screen shall meet a specified contrast ratio.
options.en: The editing screen shall meet a specified contrast ratio.

explanation.fr: Réponse proposée : a. « The editor shall provide the user with the ability to open a file » : capacité fonctionnelle. Les autres sont des contraintes : taille, utilisabilité, délai, contraste.
explanation.en: Proposed answer: a. A capability to open a file is functional; file size, usability score, delivery date and contrast ratio are limits or quality levels.

question.fr: Which statements correctly interpret “All systems of the product line shall allow users to save a file”?
question.en: Which statements correctly interpret “All systems of the product line shall allow users to save a file”?

options.fr: Only premium products must provide saving.
options.en: Only premium products must provide saving.

options.fr: Every user must save a file during every session.
options.en: Every user must save a file during every session.

options.fr: Saving is a common required capability within this stated scope.
options.en: Saving is a common required capability within this stated scope.

options.fr: Every product must implement saving using identical source code.
options.en: Every product must implement saving using identical source code.

options.fr: The requirement is intended to apply to every product in the defined family.
options.en: The requirement is intended to apply to every product in the defined family.

explanation.fr: Réponse proposée : c, e. « All systems of the product line shall… » : exigence **commune** à toute la famille dans le périmètre. (a), (b), (d) ajoutent des conditions que la phrase ne contient pas.
explanation.en: Proposed answer: c, e. “All systems … shall” states a common requirement for the whole family scope (c, e); it adds no condition on premium products, sessions or identical source code.

question.fr: Consider “When a user requests export, those systems that include Export shall ask for a destination file.” Which statements follow?
question.en: Consider “When a user requests export, those systems that include Export shall ask for a destination file.” Which statements follow?

options.fr: The export request is a triggering condition within applicable products.
options.en: The export request is a triggering condition within applicable products.

options.fr: Every product must include Export because the sentence contains shall.
options.en: Every product must include Export because the sentence contains shall.

options.fr: The request creates the Export feature in products that lack it.
options.en: The request creates the Export feature in products that lack it.

options.fr: Including Export determines the product subset to which the obligation applies.
options.en: Including Export determines the product subset to which the obligation applies.

options.fr: A product without Export violates the requirement whenever any user requests export elsewhere.
options.en: A product without Export violates the requirement whenever any user requests export elsewhere.

explanation.fr: Réponse proposée : a, d. « When a user requests export » est la **condition** (partie 1 du gabarit) ; « those systems that include Export » **délimite le sous-ensemble** de produits concernés. (b) shall n'impose pas d'inclure Export ; (c) et (e) faux.
explanation.en: Proposed answer: a, d. “When a user requests export” is a triggering condition (a); “those systems that include Export” delimits the subset of products (d). Shall does not force Export into every product.

question.fr: For this question, “eventually save” means that saving occurs at some future time, without a fixed upper bound. Which statements follow?
question.en: For this question, “eventually save” means that saving occurs at some future time, without a fixed upper bound. Which statements follow?

options.fr: The phrase authorises never saving.
options.en: The phrase authorises never saving.

options.fr: The phrase does not establish a maximum saving delay.
options.en: The phrase does not establish a maximum saving delay.

options.fr: If bounded data-loss exposure is required, a measurable timing condition should be agreed.
options.en: If bounded data-loss exposure is required, a measurable timing condition should be agreed.

options.fr: A finite observation with no save is insufficient by itself to disprove eventual saving.
options.en: A finite observation with no save is insufficient by itself to disprove eventual saving.

options.fr: Eventually is equivalent to within five seconds.
options.en: Eventually is equivalent to within five seconds.

explanation.fr: Réponse proposée : b, c, d. *Eventually* = un jour, sans borne : aucun délai maximal (b) ; s'il faut borner la perte de données, convenir d'un critère mesurable (c) ; une observation finie sans sauvegarde ne réfute pas « eventually » (d). (a) « jamais » est contraire à eventually ; (e) faux.
explanation.en: Proposed answer: b, c, d. “Eventually” sets no maximum delay (b); bounded exposure needs an agreed measurable timing condition (c); a finite observation without a save does not disprove it (d). It does not allow never saving.

question.fr: A requirement states “The editor shall be user-friendly.” Which additions would directly make its acceptance more objective?
question.en: A requirement states “The editor shall be user-friendly.” Which additions would directly make its acceptance more objective?

options.fr: A defined user population and representative tasks.
options.en: A defined user population and representative tasks.

options.fr: A declaration that the tool accepted the sentence.
options.en: A declaration that the tool accepted the sentence.

options.fr: A measurable success threshold under stated test conditions.
options.en: A measurable success threshold under stated test conditions.

options.fr: A higher StakeholderPriority value without changing the description.
options.en: A higher StakeholderPriority value without changing the description.

options.fr: A new identifier without specifying observable behaviour or criteria.
options.en: A new identifier without specifying observable behaviour or criteria.

explanation.fr: Réponse proposée : a, c. Rendre « user-friendly » objectif : définir la population et des tâches représentatives (a), un seuil mesurable dans des conditions de test fixées (c). (b), (d), (e) ne changent pas le contenu.
explanation.en: Proposed answer: a, c. A defined user population with representative tasks (a) and a measurable threshold under stated test conditions (c) make acceptance objective; a new identifier or priority does not.

question.fr: Feature A can be implemented without feature B, but its business benefit is realised only when B is available. Which statements match the appendix's distinctions?
question.en: Feature A can be implemented without feature B, but its business benefit is realised only when B is available. Which statements match the appendix's distinctions?

options.fr: The only relevant relation is a version-evolution link.
options.en: The only relevant relation is a version-evolution link.

options.fr: A is necessarily impossible to implement until B is implemented.
options.en: A is necessarily impossible to implement until B is implemented.

options.fr: The team should document what benefit depends on B.
options.en: The team should document what benefit depends on B.

options.fr: A Contribution relation can capture the benefit dependence.
options.en: A Contribution relation can capture the benefit dependence.

options.fr: The premise proves that selecting A and B is forbidden.
options.en: The premise proves that selecting A and B is forbidden.

explanation.fr: Réponse proposée : c, d. Annexe 1 : la relation **Contribution** exprime que la valeur de A n'est réalisée que si B existe, alors que A peut être implémentée sans B. On documente de quoi dépend le bénéfice (c, d). (a), (b), (e) : mauvaise relation ou conclusion interdite par l'énoncé.
explanation.en: Proposed answer: c, d. Contribution captures benefit that depends on another requirement (d), and the team documents that dependence (c). It is not about whether A can be implemented, and it forbids nothing.

question.fr: The case introduction says that all editors will feature autosave. Its later structured FR9 says “Those editors that have the autosave feature shall autosave the text eventually.” Which review findings are justified?
question.en: The case introduction says that all editors will feature autosave. Its later structured FR9 says “Those editors that have the autosave feature shall autosave the text eventually.” Which review findings are justified?

options.fr: If autosave is intended for every product, that commonality should be stated explicitly.
options.en: If autosave is intended for every product, that commonality should be stated explicitly.

options.fr: The intended family-wide availability of autosave must be clarified.
options.en: The intended family-wide availability of autosave must be clarified.

options.fr: The later statement does not itself require every editor to include autosave.
options.en: The later statement does not itself require every editor to include autosave.

options.fr: Choosing the more recent-looking sentence proves stakeholder agreement.
options.en: Choosing the more recent-looking sentence proves stakeholder agreement.

options.fr: The two statements necessarily impose identical feature availability.
options.en: The two statements necessarily impose identical feature availability.

explanation.fr: Réponse proposée : a, b, c. La phrase FR9 (« Those editors that have the autosave feature shall autosave… eventually ») ne force pas chaque éditeur à inclure autosave (c) ; si autosave doit être commun, il faut le dire (a) et clarifier (b). (d) une phrase plus récente ne prouve pas l'accord ; (e) les deux ne disent pas la même chose.
explanation.en: Proposed answer: a, b, c. FR9 only targets editors that have the autosave feature (c); if autosave is meant for all, say so (a) and clarify (b). The most recent sentence proves no agreement.

question.fr: A team exports an SRS from Domain Requirements - AC. Requirements appear in sections, but project-description fields are blank and two requirements prescribe incompatible behaviour under the same condition. Which statements are correct?
question.en: A team exports an SRS from Domain Requirements - AC. Requirements appear in sections, but project-description fields are blank and two requirements prescribe incompatible behaviour under the same condition. Which statements are correct?

options.fr: The existence of section headings proves all required content is present.
options.en: The existence of section headings proves all required content is present.

options.fr: The project-description fields still need completion.
options.en: The project-description fields still need completion.

options.fr: The conflict must be reviewed and resolved with appropriate stakeholders.
options.en: The conflict must be reviewed and resolved with appropriate stakeholders.

options.fr: Word generation proves the specification is internally consistent.
options.en: Word generation proves the specification is internally consistent.

options.fr: A conflict should be hidden by giving both requirements the same identifier.
options.en: A conflict should be hidden by giving both requirements the same identifier.

explanation.fr: Réponse proposée : b, c. Des champs vides sont à compléter (b) ; un conflit doit être traité avec les parties prenantes (c). (a), (d) : titres de sections et génération Word ne prouvent ni complétude ni cohérence ; (e) cacher un conflit est une erreur.
explanation.en: Proposed answer: b, c. Blank project fields still need completion (b); conflicts must be resolved with stakeholders (c). Headings and Word generation prove neither completeness nor consistency.

question.fr: A team replaces “user-friendly” with this proposed criterion: “Under test protocol U, at least 90% of first-time users from population P shall save a document within 60 seconds without assistance.” Which statements are justified?
question.en: A team replaces “user-friendly” with this proposed criterion: “Under test protocol U, at least 90% of first-time users from population P shall save a document within 60 seconds without assistance.” Which statements are justified?

options.fr: Stakeholders should validate whether these measures represent the intended usability need.
options.en: Stakeholders should validate whether these measures represent the intended usability need.

options.fr: Protocol U and population P must be defined for reproducible assessment.
options.en: Protocol U and population P must be defined for reproducible assessment.

options.fr: The 90% threshold is already mandated by the tutorial.
options.en: The 90% threshold is already mandated by the tutorial.

options.fr: Saving performance alone proves that every aspect of usability is satisfied.
options.en: Saving performance alone proves that every aspect of usability is satisfied.

options.fr: The proposal introduces observable success and timing thresholds.
options.en: The proposal introduces observable success and timing thresholds.

explanation.fr: Réponse proposée : a, b, e. Le critère introduit des seuils observables (e) ; protocole U et population P doivent être définis (b) ; les parties prenantes valident que ces mesures traduisent bien le besoin (a). (c) le tutoriel ne fixe pas 90 % ; (d) un seul test ne prouve pas toute l'utilisabilité.
explanation.en: Proposed answer: a, b, e. The criterion introduces observable thresholds (e); protocol U and population P must be defined (b); stakeholders validate that it captures the need (a). The 90% is not mandated by the tutorial and one test does not prove all of usability.

question.fr: Use only these rules: Align is optional; if Align is selected and FontFamily=System, Alignment must be Centered. Which statements follow?
question.en: Use only these rules: Align is optional; if Align is selected and FontFamily=System, Alignment must be Centered. Which statements follow?

options.fr: Every product must select Align.
options.en: Every product must select Align.

options.fr: A product without Align is not excluded by this rule alone.
options.en: A product without Align is not excluded by this rule alone.

options.fr: Every product must use the System font family.
options.en: Every product must use the System font family.

options.fr: A product with Align, System and Left alignment violates the rule.
options.en: A product with Align, System and Left alignment violates the rule.

options.fr: A product with Align, System and Centered alignment satisfies this rule.
options.en: A product with Align, System and Centered alignment satisfies this rule.

explanation.fr: Réponse proposée : b, d, e. Align est optionnel : un produit sans Align n'est pas exclu par cette règle (b). Avec Align + System, seul Centered satisfait la règle : Left la viole (d), Centered la satisfait (e). (a), (c) faux.
explanation.en: Proposed answer: b, d, e. Align is optional, so a product without it is not excluded (b). With Align and System, only Centered satisfies the rule: Left violates it (d), Centered satisfies it (e).
